hero.body: Transform into your best self even with a demanding 9-5, travel and family. A system built around your real week. Not a 12-week crash.

ticker.text: Fat Loss ✦ Muscle Gain ✦ Busy Professionals ✦ Custom Training ✦ Flexible Nutrition ✦ Travel-Proof Plans ✦ Weekly Check-ins ✦ Direct Accountability ✦

problem.heading: You don't lack willpower. You lack a system that fits your week.
problem.pivot: You already deliver for everyone: your boss, your team, your family. What's missing is a plan built around your actual routine, and someone who keeps you accountable to it.
problem.pain1: Generic plans ignore your calendar.Templates written for people with two spare hours a day collapse the moment a late meeting, a flight or a family dinner shows up.
problem.pain2: All-or-nothing diets never survive real life.Cut everything out and it works for three weeks, then one weekend undoes it, and the guilt costs more than the calories.
problem.pain3: Nobody is actually checking on you.Without a weekly review and someone who notices when you slip, motivation quietly becomes the plan. Motivation is not a plan.

story.heading: Coaching built for the life you actually live.
story.lead: I'm Pratyush. I help working professionals lose fat and build muscle without putting their careers, their travel or their family time on hold.
story.p1: Most plans are written for people with two spare hours a day. Real professionals don't have that. They have early meetings, deadlines, client dinners, flights and families. So the plan has to be built around the week you actually have, not the one a template assumes.
story.p2: That's the whole idea: a system that fits your life, not the other way around.
story.p3: Personalised training around your schedule and equipment. Flexible nutrition that survives travel and eating out. Weekly check-ins, form reviews and direct access, so small problems get fixed before they turn into plateaus, and so you actually understand the deeper concepts, not just follow orders.
story.pull: Your schedule isn't the obstacle. It's the thing we build the plan around.
story.p4: Every client works with me for 3, 6 or 12 months and finishes with the habits, mindset and a maintenance plan to keep the results for good. My job isn't to hand you a 12-week fix, it's to make sure you never need one again.

system.heading:
Everything is built for you.
Nothing is templated.
system.sub: One coach. One system. Every part of it adjusts to your week, not the other way around, whether you commit for 3, 6 or 12 months.

card1.title: Personalized Training Schedule
card1.body: Built around your equipment, experience and the hours you actually have, whether that's a commercial gym at 6 a.m. or forty-five minutes in a hotel gym between meetings.

card2.title: Nutrition That Fits Your Life
card2.body: Structured targets around the foods you actually eat: client dinners, weekends and travel included. No meal-prep servitude, no banned lists.

card3.title: Travel & Holiday Management
card3.body: Flights, hotels, work trips and holidays planned for in advance, so momentum survives your calendar instead of dying on it.

card4.title: Check-in Calls & Direct Chat
card4.body: One-on-one calls plus direct chat access to Pratyush, not a portal, not an assistant. Questions answered within the day.

card5.title: Full Metrics Tracking
card5.body: Bodyweight, performance, sleep, stress and recovery in one place. We read the trend, and the plan updates the moment the data asks for it.

card6.title: Form Reviews & Mindset
card6.body: Weekly exercise videos with form feedback, plus the habits, adherence and mindset systems that make results actually stick.

results.heading: Proof over promises.
results.sub: Different jobs, different schedules, same system. Every client below did the work around a full, busy life, not in spite of it.
results.note: ※ Real client submissions to Pratyush Liftz. Aggregate counters below are placeholders - confirm before publishing.

step1.title: Apply
step1.body: Send a DM or fill the short application. We talk about your goal, your schedule and your history, a straightforward conversation to see whether this is the right fit, on both sides.

step2.title: Blueprint
step2.body: Within 48 hours of onboarding you receive your complete system: training schedule, nutrition targets, tracking setup and the first habits we'll install, all built around your real week.

step3.title: Execute & adjust
step3.body: You train, you eat, you report. Every week the data comes back, the plan evolves, and the results compound, through busy seasons, travel and real life. Finish with a maintenance plan that holds.

fit.heading:
This is coaching, not content.
It has to fit.
yesItems: Run a demanding schedule (9-5, travel, family) and refuse to let it be the excuse.
Can commit 3-5 focused hours a week to training.
Want a lean, strong body you can actually maintain, not a 12-week stunt.
Prefer honest feedback and data over hype.
noItems: You're looking for a quick fix, a detox or a shortcut.
You want a plan but not the accountability that comes with it.
You expect the coach to want it more than you do.

quote.text: "You don't need more hours in the day. You need a system that respects the ones you have."

faq.heading: Honest answers to fair questions.
faq.sub: Anything else? Ask it in your application. You'll get a direct answer, not a pitch.

p1.title: The commitment
p1.body: You choose to work with me for 3, 6 or 12 months. Longer isn't upselling, it's how lasting change actually happens, and how habits get built for good.

p2.title: Scope & boundaries
p2.body: This coaching is educational, not medical care or nutrition therapy. Your photos and metrics stay in a private folder shared only with you, and nothing is ever posted without your permission.

p3.title: After the transformation
p3.body: You don't get left to gain it all back. You finish with a maintenance plan and a clear set of guidelines to permanently sustain your transformation.

enquiry.heading: Start the conversation.
enquiry.sub: Tell Pratyush where you are and where you want to be. You'll get a personal reply: an honest assessment of whether this system fits your life, and what it would look like if it does.
enquiry.assure: An application is not a commitment. No payment details, no pressure, no automated sales sequence. One conversation, then you decide.
enquiry.formPreview: A short application: your goal, your schedule and where you are now. It takes about two minutes.
enquiry.formNote: Opens the application form. Pratyush reads every submission personally and replies himself, not a bot, not a sales team.

faqs.q: How much time does this actually take?
faqs.a: Most clients train 3-5 hours per week, plus about ten minutes a day for tracking. The program is built around your real availability in week one. If your schedule changes, the plan changes with it.

faqs.q: Do I need a gym, or specific equipment?
faqs.a: No. Programs are written for whatever you have: a full commercial gym, a home setup, or hotel gyms while travelling. The system adapts to the tools, not the reverse.

faqs.q: I travel and eat out a lot. Will this survive that?
faqs.a: It's designed for exactly that. Your nutrition runs on flexible targets and real-world strategies rather than rigid meal plans, and travel, holidays and client dinners are planned for in advance, not punished.

faqs.q: What happens in a weekly check-in?
faqs.a: You submit your data, photos and any form videos; Pratyush reviews everything, records a response covering what's working and what changes next week, and you talk through anything that needs a decision on a call or voice note.

faqs.q: How soon will I see results?
faqs.a: Most clients see measurable change on the scale and tape within three to four weeks, and visible change in photos by weeks six to eight. The honest answer: speed depends on your consistency, and consistency is exactly what the system is built to protect.

faqs.q: How long do I sign up for?
faqs.a: Coaching runs in 3, 6 or 12-month commitments. Longer isn't upselling, it's how lasting change actually happens. Every client finishes with a maintenance plan so the results hold once coaching ends.
